10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

11083|53d41aed.name: Darianna
11083|53d41aed.text: It's so exciting to be here in Darnassus, surrounded by talented people! I just know I'm going to make my family proud. Maybe if I'm really lucky, the Sentinels will ask me to join their forces on the front!

11798|26b6c691.name: Bunthen Plainswind
11798|26b6c691.text: If you're looking for a flight back to Rut'theran Village, then you should talk to my night elven counterpart, Silva Fil'naveth.

11799|afaf02f4.name: Tajarri
11799|afaf02f4.text:
May Cenarius watch over you, sister.

I am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.

11800|2051e10a.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|2051e10a.text: Would you like a flight to Rut'theran Village, courtesy of the Cenarion Circle?

11800|d5d73f6c.name: Silva Fil'naveth
11800|d5d73f6c.text:
In the northern part of Darkshore runs the Cliffspring River, flowing down from the lands now known as Felwood.  As the river flows out and empties out into the Mist's Edge, travel north to where the deepest parts of the ocean begin.  A stone formation that some call the Stone Claw due to its shape is where you may find what you seek.

Be warned - threshers gather by the Stone Claw, and will attack those who trespass on their territory.

11802|ef8483c2.name: Dendrite Starblaze
11802|ef8483c2.text:
Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.

While you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

12042|e653c173.name: Loganaar
12042|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

277042|893a469d.name: Teuren Vineshade
277042|893a469d.text:
Welcome to my barbershop! We offer cuts, colorings, and more.

We can groom facial hair, perform piercings, ink $r tattoos, anything you might need.

Have a seat and we'll get to work.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

3516|cc6cb2bd.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
3516|cc6cb2bd.text: Make it quick, $c. Observing and guiding the growth of Teldrassil leaves me with little time to waste to idle banter.

3519|f7f9ee95.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
3519|f7f9ee95.text: I, Arynia Cloudsbreak, have been tasked with protecting the sanctity of the Oracle Grove.

3571|497f7ea2.name: Dolanaar Sentinel
3571|497f7ea2.text: There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil.  Tell me what you seek.

3602|61371b1a.name: Kal
3602|61371b1a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming.  Never forget this.

3605|08c2dba0.name: Nadyia Maneweaver
3605|08c2dba0.text: You need to make your stitches smaller, $N. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4211|a28d29e1.name: Dannelor
4211|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4217|34f0a84a.name: Mathrengyl Bearwalker
4217|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4219|34f0a84a.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|34f0a84a.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There are rumors of strife within the Cenarion Circle, but you should pay such loose talk no heed.  Our Arch $C, Fandral Staghelm, leads us and all of Teldrassil to glory!

4219|8fca8484.name: Fylerian Nightwing
4219|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4753|b87a8862.name: Jartsam
4753|b87a8862.text: I can teach you the finer points of Tiger Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6299|bb66b6f6.name: Delfrum Flintbeard
6299|bb66b6f6.text: I just can't seem to get comfortable without a sturdy ceiling of granite over my head. All these stars up there, enough to give ye the shivers.

6301|021e8521.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|021e8521.text: Greetings lass, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6737|41276936.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

7999|3d397bbf.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
7999|3d397bbf.text: Greetings, $c. I am Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune.

1001-progress.name: Unknown
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1002-progress.name: Unknown
1002-progress.text: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent gnome ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?
1002-progress.title: Buzzbox 323

2518-progress.name: Priestess A'moora
2518-progress.text:
I regret the task that I have asked you to carry out; but Lady Sathrah is beyond hope.

It is our hope to offer the sacrifice of the spinnerets to Elune. With this sacrifice, Elune will bless Sathrah so that she might be reborn, and at peace.
2518-progress.title: Tears of the Moon

2541-progress.name: Oben Rageclaw
2541-progress.text: If I can examine the charm, I may be able to figure out how to break the enchantment. Have you found one?
2541-progress.title: The Sleeping Druid

29-progress.name: Tajarri
29-progress.text: To complete the Trial of the Lake, you must use the Shrine Bauble within the boundaries of this shrine.  Until you do so, your trial remains unfinished and it is at risk of failure.
29-progress.title: Trial of the Lake

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4723-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4723-progress.text:
Perhaps one day we'll find a means to prevent these poor creatures from ending their lives needlessly on the coast of Darkshore.  Until then, we must continue our research!

Greetings $N - what news do you bring?
4723-progress.title: Beached Sea Creature

4740-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
4740-progress.text: Greetings $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today?  Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Murkdeep?
4740-progress.title: WANTED: Murkdeep!

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4812-progress.name: Unknown
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

483-progress.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-progress.text:
$N, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.
483-progress.title: The Relics of Wakening

6122-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
6122-progress.text:
You're the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent?  That's wonderful!  We've quite the crisis our hands here regarding the poor deer, and we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have?  He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...
6122-progress.title: The Principal Source

7383-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
7383-progress.text: Along with the druids, the Oracle Tree and the Arch $C have been carefully monitoring the growth of Teldrassil. But though we have a new home, our immortal lives have not been restored.
7383-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

923-progress.name: Rellian Greenspyre
923-progress.text: Have you been to Wellspring Lake, $N?  Have you been hunting the timberlings there?
923-progress.title: Tumors

930-progress.name: Denalan
930-progress.text: $N, you look like you have something to tell me.  Do you have news concerning the timberlings?
930-progress.title: The Glowing Fruit

933-progress.name: Corithras Moonrage
933-progress.text: At first the reports of crazed furbolg attacks were dismissed. Who could have thought that the peace-loving bear-men would turn to mindless rage? Yet another of the problems that plagues us here in our new home.
933-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

935-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
935-progress.text:
I know that I did not summon you, so I cannot help but wonder why it is you have come to speak with me.

Whatever it is, please make it quick.
935-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

937-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
937-progress.text: Their slashing talons and piercing beaks may prove a difficult match for your own abilities, $N, but I have faith that you will not fail in this task.
937-progress.title: The Enchanted Glade

940-progress.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
940-progress.text: Hmm... You come with the spirit of the forest strongly within you, $c. What business do you have with the Arch $C of the Kaldorei?
940-progress.title: Teldrassil

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98046-accept.name: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
98046-accept.text:
<Arch $C Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.>

You're still here?

Take the phial and get out of my sight, $c. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. 

Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it.

<Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.>

I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
98046-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

98065-progress.name: Tyrande Whisperwind
98065-progress.text: Please state your business. I have a city to run, and a people to lead.
98065-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

983-progress.name: Unknown
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98392-progress.name: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak
98392-progress.text: Have you wrested the amulets from the harpies' leaders?
98392-progress.title: Darkness in the Glade

98403-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
98403-progress.text:
<Tallonkai lowers his voice.>

Does Xethorr still walk freely?
98403-progress.title: Twisted Hatred

99050-progress.name: Byancie
99050-progress.text: Do you have the ingredients? I fear Eralya may not have long.
99050-progress.title: The Great Tree Provides
